body-compact.purpose: Secondary sentences, field values, and helper text.

code.purpose: The prompt, including its line numbers.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Surfaces stay flat. Depth is a graphite step or a 1px seam.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for the tree expand, the add popover, and the property drawer.

motion.name: popover-in
motion.purpose: Add popover entrance, from the top edge.

components.name: Keyword Button
components.description: The empty-state fill. Keyword is the only button fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-keyword { background: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); color: var(--ground, #0D1117); font-family: var(--sans, "Lexend Variable", "Lexend", sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.75; text-transform: none; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 16px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-keyword:hover { background: var(--keyword-light, #9DCEFF); } .ds-btn-keyword:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--keyword, #79C0FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-keyword:disabled { background: rgba(121, 192, 255, 0.18); color: rgba(13, 17, 23, 0.55); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The add control inside the popover. An outline, not a fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #E6EDF3); font-family: var(--sans, "Lexend Variable", "Lexend", sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 560; letter-spacing: 0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.75; text-transform: none; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #262C36); border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 16px; width: 100%; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); background: rgba(121, 192, 255, 0.08); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--keyword, #79C0FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { border-color: var(--seam, #262C36); color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 0.45); }

components.name: Destructive Control
components.description: Clear and delete. Dashed seam at rest; destructive red only on hover or focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-destructive" aria-label="Clear all components"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V5h6v2M8 7l1 12h6l1-12" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #8B949E); border: 1px dashed var(--seam, #262C36); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px; display: inline-flex; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover, .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: var(--destructive, #F85149); color: var(--destructive, #F85149); background: transparent; outline: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:disabled { border-color: transparent; color: rgba(139, 148, 158, 0.4); }

components.name: Copy Control
components.description: The prompt’s keyword fill. The other half of the two-fill rule.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-copy" aria-label="Copy to clipboard"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="8" y="8" width="11" height="11" rx="1" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><path d="M5 15V5h10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-copy { background: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); color: var(--ground, #0D1117); border: 0; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px; display: inline-flex; box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-copy:hover { background: var(--keyword-light, #9DCEFF); } .ds-btn-copy:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--keyword, #79C0FF); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-copy:disabled { background: rgba(121, 192, 255, 0.18); color: rgba(13, 17, 23, 0.45); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Property editor field. Ground interior, seam border, keyword on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: var(--sans, "Lexend Variable", "Lexend", sans-serif); font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #8B949E); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field input { background: var(--ground, #0D1117); color: var(--text, #E6EDF3); border: 1px solid var(--seam, #262C36); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8.5px 14px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--muted, #8B949E); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); outline: 1px solid var(--keyword, #79C0FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Chip
components.description: Category filter. Filled when selected, outlined when not.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(121, 192, 255, 0.16); color: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: var(--sans, "Lexend Variable", "Lexend", sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--text, #E6EDF3); border-color: var(--seam, #262C36); }

components.name: Panel Header
components.description: 40px small-caps title bar for the tree, the prompt, and the add popover.
components.css: .ds-panel-header { height: 40px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px 0 16px; background: var(--panel, #151A22); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--seam, #262C36); } .ds-panel-header span { font-family: var(--sans, "Lexend Variable", "Lexend", sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; line-height: 1; font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted, #8B949E); }

components.name: Tree Row
components.description: A selected component name in the same face and keyword color as the prompt.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--keyword, #79C0FF); background: rgba(121, 192, 255, 0.14); } .ds-tree-name { font-family: var(--mono, "Fira Code Variable", "Fira Code", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); font-weight: 560; } .ds-prop-count { font-family: var(--mono, "Fira Code Variable", "Fira Code", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--number, #C678DD); height: 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--seam, #262C36); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-tree-text { font-family: var(--mono, "Fira Code Variable", "Fira Code", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; color: var(--string, #56D364); }

components.name: Prompt Sheet
components.description: The prompt, with a 1px ruler beside tabular line numbers.
components.css: .ds-prompt { display: flex; gap: 12px; position: relative; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: var(--mono, "Fira Code Variable", "Fira Code", ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text, #E6EDF3); background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 2.6rem, var(--seam, #262C36) 2.6rem, var(--seam, #262C36) calc(2.6rem + 1px), transparent calc(2.6rem + 1px)); } .ds-line { color: var(--muted, #8B949E); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; width: 2rem; } .ds-kw { color: var(--keyword, #79C0FF); } .ds-str { color: var(--string, #56D364); }

narrative.overview:
SPUIG’s working surface is a graphite developer console. The component tree and the prompt preview sit on one panel plane and meet at a single 1px seam. Chrome stays in Lexend; component names and the prompt stay in Fira Code, so the tree and the prompt read as the same syntax.

Color is syntax state. Keyword blue is the only fill, used for the empty-state “Add first component” control and the Copy control. String green, number violet, warning gold, and destructive red appear in code and validation. Graphite does the rest: ground, panel, and elevated, separated by the seam. Panels are square. Controls are 4px. There is no drop shadow.

Destructive actions are a dashed outline in the seam color, held apart by empty space, and turn red only on hover or focus. Below 1200px the stage stacks the tree, then the preview. At 1200px and wider the tree and preview share the width one to two.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, panel, and elevated surfaces
One 1px seam between tree and prompt
Color only as syntax state; keyword is the only fill
Lexend for chrome, Fira Code for names and the prompt
Small-caps panel headers and tabular figures
Dashed destructive controls that turn red only on hover or focus

rules.name: The Syntax-Only Rule
rules.body: Keyword is the only fill. String (#56D364) colors prompt strings and tree text content. Number (#C678DD) colors prompt numbers, booleans, and the property-count chip. Warning (#E3B341) and destructive (#F85149) color validation. None of them paint a surface.

rules.name: The Shared Syntax Rule
rules.body: Component names and the prompt use Fira Code Variable. Lexend does not appear inside the prompt or on a component name.

rules.name: The Flat Seam Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A change of graphite, or a 1px seam, is the whole depth system.

dos: Do keep surfaces on Graphite Ground, Graphite Panel, and Raised Graphite, split by a 1px seam.
Do use Syntax Keyword as the only fill, and only for “Add first component” and Copy.
Do make the popover add control an outline with a seam border.
Do draw destructive actions as a dashed seam outline, isolated by empty space, turning destructive red only on hover or focus.
Do set component names and the prompt in Fira Code Variable, and chrome in Lexend Variable, with tabular figures.
Do set panel titles in the 40px bar: 11px, weight 600, tracking 0.14em, small-caps, ash.
Do use a 4px radius on controls and a square corner on panels.
Do stack the tree above the preview below 1200px, and split them one to two from 1200px up.
donts: Don't paint a panel, header, or large region in keyword, string, number, warning, or destructive.
Don't add a drop shadow. Depth is a graphite step or a 1px seam.
Don't round panels, the header, or scrollbar thumbs.
Don't show destructive red on a control that is at rest.
Don't set a second accent. The theme’s secondary and info roles are aliases of keyword, not another hue.
Don't put a small-caps eyebrow above a heading or a form group. Small-caps belong to the 40px panel title.
